name: ORC-mkX Arms SecondWind
description:
The mark X is part of CDS’ award-winning Omni-Role Combat armor series. This EVA-rated suit features new EdgeCore composite weave technology, maximizing protection against projectiles, explosives and the elements while minimizing operator agility.

To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the armor with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design.
